title: 赠汪伦
author: Li Bai

translation: li bai is about to set off in his boat
when suddenly he hears stamping and singing on the shore
the peach blossom pool runs a thousand feet deep
yet it still falls short of the love wang lun gives me

appreciation: Li Bai is already in the boat when Wang Lun and his friends begin stamping their feet and singing a farewell song on the shore. The poet answers with a playful boast: even a pool a thousand feet deep cannot measure this friendship. The poem matters because its warmth is so direct and unguarded, turning a simple goodbye into one of the most quoted expressions of friendship in Chinese.
